coverage_notes: Swept foundational/seminal works (Chen ER model, Shneiderman, Tufte, Munzner), peer-reviewed literature (ACM/VLDB/IEEE/arXiv on database visualization, graph layout, visual analytics), schema representation across paradigms (relational, NoSQL, RDF/graphs, JSON), visualization theory applied to schema (information scent, cognitive load, gestalt principles), ER model extensions (EER, HERM), query visualization and representation, graph aesthetics and readability, interactive exploration and discovery, schema complexity metrics, and specific tools/implementations (pgModeler, dbdiagram, visualization frameworks). Covered diagram notations (Chen, Crow's Foot, UML), dimensional modeling and warehousing, temporal and versioning aspects, constraint visualization, hierarchical data representation, and multi-view coordinated visualization. Sources deduplicated across search result sets. T0 entries are meta-analyses/systematic reviews and primary seminal papers; T1 entries are peer-reviewed conferences (CHI/UIST/VLDB/IEEE) and arXiv preprints; T2 entries are textbooks, canonical author works, and high-quality research articles; T3 entries are practitioner resources, tool documentation, and technical guides. Notable gaps: user studies on schema comprehension (sparse coverage), longitudinal adoption studies of visualization tools, and cross-cultural design perspectives. Authoritatively covers: Chen (ER model), Shneiderman (information visualization taxonomy), Tufte (visualization principles), Pirolli (information foraging), Munzner (visualization design framework), force-directed layout algorithms, query visualization (Gatterbauer et al., VLDB), NoSQL schema visualization, RDF/knowledge graph visualization, and contemporary research on schema discovery and abstraction.

sources.title: The Entity-Relationship Model—Toward a Unified View of Data
sources.notes: Foundational seminal paper introducing the ER model; Chen, P.P.S., published in ACM Transactions on Database Systems, 1(1), 1976, pp. 9-36. Establishes the conceptual framework for database schema representation and entity-relationship diagrams.

sources.title: The Eyes Have It: A Task by Data Type Taxonomy for Information Visualizations

sources.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information (and subsequent works on data-ink ratio and visualization principles)

sources.title: Information Foraging Theory: Adaptive Interaction with Information

sources.title: Visualization Analysis & Design (chapters on data/task abstraction and visualization grammar)
